name: tpl-chain-response-1-nogoal-carry~p1
task: Should the box fall, make your very next move the one that picks it back up. If you get to the exit, you must have the box in your hands.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires reaching the exit unconditionally, but both clauses are rules and neither makes `at_exit` happen; the empty FINAL_STATES confirms there is no hard goal. Add a hard Existence(at_exit). Keep the two hard rules: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) captures the next-step pickup, and Response(at_exit, holding_box) captures having the box at the exit.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) cannot enforce having the box at the exit. It allows holding_box to become true later, and at_exit is only true on the terminal step, so the rule remains owed when the episode ends. Replace it with a hard Precedence(holding_box, at_exit), which requires the box to be held when reaching the exit. Keep the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires having the box in hand when you reach the exit. Precedence(holding_box, at_exit) only forbids reaching the exit before holding the box at least once; it does not require holding it at the exit. Replace it with Response(at_exit, holding_box), which enforces that the box is held on the exit step. Keep the hard ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) for picking the box up on the very next step.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` does not ensure the box is held when reaching the exit; it allows holding the box only later. The task requires the box in hand at the exit. Replace it with a same-step condition, such as `Response(holding_box, at_exit)` would not express that either; use a clause that requires `holding_box` at `at_exit`.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires pickup on the very next step, and Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires the box in hand at the exit. The exit condition is a one-step, last-step proposition, so the response is satisfied only when holding_box is true at the exit.

texts: If the box falls, pick it up on the very next step.
If you reach the exit, have the box in your hands.
